title: Cooking Without Power
description: Explains carbon monoxide risk and which cooking methods are safe indoors (fireplace, chafing dishes, fondue pots) versus outdoors only (grills, camp stoves, fires, rocket and solar stoves). Covers fuel storage, retained-heat cooking, food safety, and simple recipes.
shortDescription: Grills and camp stoves outdoors only, safe indoor warmers, and fuel tips
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
